correctness.rationale: For all m,k>=0, a residual of (ab)^(m+k) after deleting an embedded (ab)^k has balanced two-letter blocks each ab or ba: the residual even-prefix imbalance is at once even and in {-1,0,1}. A ba-block run requires a new deleted a, giving at most k such runs. Conversely each run (ba)^q comes from (ab)^(q+1) with endpoints a,b deleted, so every block word with <=k ba-runs occurs. Selecting 2r of m+1 block boundaries yields C(m+1,2r), equal by Pascal summation to the binomial tail. This proves the full-attainment threshold m<=2k and its unique first missing word. Independently enumerated distinct deletion residuals at 0<=k<=n<=8, consistent with the formula.
